_comment: HEURISTIC. Expected organic CTR by rounded average position (1-20), as a fraction. These are illustrative defaults, not measurements: they are not taken from a published study, they do not account for AI Overviews, ads, or other SERP features, and real curves vary a lot by site, query type and brand share. Fit your own: ctr-audit.mjs and striking-distance.mjs fit this curve from your site's query-level Search Console rows (median CTR by rounded position) whenever there is enough data, and fall back to this file otherwise. Pass --curve default to force this file.
label: illustrative defaults; fit your own
